name: io.github.CynaCons/powerchannel
title: PowerChannel
description: Named channels so AI agents in different apps on one computer can message each other

environmentVariables.name: POWERCHANNEL_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the shared SQLite database. Every app must use the same one; the default is the per-user data folder.

environmentVariables.name: POWERCHANNEL_MAX_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Longest read wait in seconds (default 43200 = 12 h).

environmentVariables.name: POWERCHANNEL_CODEX
environmentVariables.description: Full path of the codex command, if the Codex app's PATH doesn't have it.
